rajasthan-golden-triangle.d: Nahargarh Fort hill path above Jaipur (out and back, about 2 to 4 miles, easy to steady, Oct-Mar); Guru Shikhar at Mount Abu (walk-up summit, short climb of about 300 steps beyond the road, steady, Oct-Mar); Bailey's Walk at Mount Abu (point to point, short, easy, Oct-Mar)
rajasthan-golden-triangle.m: Ranakpur to Kumbhalgarh in Kumbhalgarh Wildlife Sanctuary (1 to 2 days, about 15 miles, forest guard required, trek, Oct-Mar)

taiwan.d: Zhuilu Old Road in Taroko (point to point, about 6 miles on an exposed cliff path, steep, permit required, currently closed); Shakadang Trail in Taroko (out and back, about 2.5 miles each way, easy, year-round); Alishan Giant Trees Trail (loop, about 1.5 miles, easy, year-round)
taiwan.m: Yushan main peak (2 days, 12,966 feet, Paiyun Lodge, steep trek, Apr-Nov; lottery permit)
taiwan.st: Zhuilu Old Road has not reopened and no date is set: Taroko National Park's 28 Aug 2026 notice reopened the Ecological Protection Area trails from 29 Aug but said the reopening of Mt. Qingshui and Zhuilu Old Road would be announced later; blogs say the road was badly damaged by the 2024 earthquake and later typhoons, including a broken suspension bridge. Existing permit applications are restored when a route reopens.

tanzania.d: Materuni Waterfall and coffee village (out and back, about 3 miles, easy, Jun-Oct); Ngorongoro crater rim walk (guided, easy to steady, Jun-Oct)
tanzania.m: Kilimanjaro by the Machame, Lemosho, Rongai and Marangu routes (5 to 9 days, about 40 to 45 miles, camping, or huts on Marangu, expedition trek, Jan-Mar and Jun-Oct); Mount Meru (3 to 4 days, huts with a ranger, steep trek, Jun-Feb)
tanzania.st: TANAPA announced on 28 Sept 2026 that the Lemosho and Londorosi routes on Kilimanjaro are temporarily suspended after a new fire, and affected climbers are being redirected to the Machame, Marangu or Rongai routes (Bernama/Xinhua). The Western Breach has reportedly been closed since 2024. No reopening date was found.

tasmania.d: Dove Lake Circuit (loop, about 3.7 miles, easy, Nov-Apr); Cradle Mountain summit (out and back, about 4 to 5 miles with a rock scramble, steep, Dec-Mar); Wineglass Bay Lookout (out and back, about 2 miles, steady, year-round)
tasmania.m: Overland Track (6 days, 40 miles, huts or camping, trek, 1 Oct-31 May booking season)

tbilisi-caucasus.d: Gergeti Trinity Church (out and back, about 3.7 miles, steep, May-Oct); Gergeti Glacier (out and back, about 12 miles, steep, Jul-Sep)
tbilisi-caucasus.m: Mestia to Ushguli (4 days, 34 miles, guesthouses, trek, Jul-Sep)

texas-hill-country.d: Enchanted Rock Summit Trail (out and back, about 1.2 miles, steep granite, Nov-Apr; day-pass reservation on busy days); Enchanted Rock Loop Trail (loop, about 4.25 miles, steady, Nov-Apr); Lost Maples East Trail (loop, about 4 miles, steady, Oct-Nov for maple color)

thailand.d: Ton Prai and Bang Pae waterfall trails in Khao Phra Thaeo (loop, about 3 to 5 miles, steady, Nov-Feb); Khao Phanom Bencha waterfall trails (out and back, steady, Nov-Feb)

tierra-del-fuego.d: Senda Costera in Tierra del Fuego National Park (point to point, about 5 miles, easy to steady, Nov-Mar); Laguna Esmeralda near Ushuaia (out and back, long day, steady, Nov-Mar)
tierra-del-fuego.m: Dientes de Navarino circuit (4 to 5 days, about 33 miles, camping, expedition trek, Dec-Mar)

tokyo-kyoto.d: Kurama to Kibune ridge path (point to point, about 3 miles, steady, Mar-Nov); Mount Takao (walk-up summit, about 2 to 4 miles, steady, year-round); Mount Mitake and the Rock Garden (loop, about 5 miles, steady, Mar-Nov)

torres-del-paine.d: Base Torres (out and back, about 12 miles, steep, Oct-Apr); Mirador Grey (out and back, about 5 miles, steady, Oct-Apr)
torres-del-paine.m: W Trek (4 to 6 days, about 40 miles, refugios or camping, trek, Oct-Apr); O Circuit (7 to 9 days, about 80 miles, refugios or camping, trek, Oct-Apr)
torres-del-paine.st: Rules for 2026 (official ticket site and secondary reports): Base Torres required an authorized guide from 27 Apr to 30 Aug 2026 and the W stayed closed in June and July; CONAF's closure of the O Circuit was extended to 31 Oct 2026. The planned capacity-controlled ticket system was postponed from 1 Jan 2026, and no 2026-27 regulations were found. Check parquetorresdelpaine.cl and pasesparques.cl.

turks-caicos.d: Crossing Place Trail on Middle Caicos (point to point, short coastal sections, easy, Nov-Apr); Bird Rock Trail on Providenciales (out and back, short, easy, Nov-Apr)

tuscany.d: Cinque Terre Sentiero Azzurro in Liguria (point to point, about 7.5 miles, steady, Mar-Nov; Cinque Terre Card needed); Pienza to Monticchiello in the Val d'Orcia (point to point, about 3.5 miles, easy, Mar-May and Sep-Oct)
tuscany.m: Via Francigena from Lucca to Siena (5 to 6 days, about 80 miles, B&Bs, trek, Mar-May and Sep-Oct)

uganda.d: Sipi Falls trails on Mount Elgon (loop, about 3 to 5 miles, easy to steady, Dec-Feb and Jun-Aug); Bwindi forest walks (guided, steep and muddy, Jun-Aug and Dec-Feb)
uganda.m: Rwenzori Central Circuit (6 to 7 days, mountain huts, strenuous trek, Jan-Mar and Jun-Aug; guide required)

uluru.d: Uluru base walk (loop, about 6.6 miles, easy, May-Sep); Valley of the Winds at Kata Tjuta (loop, about 4.6 miles, steady, May-Sep); Kings Canyon Rim Walk (loop, about 3.7 miles, steady, May-Sep)
uluru.st: Uluru base walk repairs after February and March 2026 storms resumed on 10 June 2026, with the track closed in sections (the Mala and Lungkata walks); the Valley of the Winds walk closes at the first lookout from 11 a.m. when the temperature reaches 36 C. Check the park's news page.

upper-peninsula.d: Chapel Loop at Pictured Rocks (loop, about 10 miles, steady, Jun-Oct); Lake of the Clouds overlook in the Porcupine Mountains (out and back, short, easy, Jun-Oct)
upper-peninsula.m: Isle Royale Greenstone Ridge (4 to 5 days, about 40 miles, camping, trek, Jun-Sep); North Country Trail through Pictured Rocks (3 to 4 days, about 42 miles, camping with a permit, trek, Jun-Oct)

uyuni.d: Isla Incahuasi (loop, about 15 minutes up, easy, May-Oct); Tunupa volcano (walk-up summit, long day or overnight, steep, May-Oct)

uzbekistan.d: Greater Chimgan (walk-up summit, long day, steep and rocky, Apr-Jun and Sep-Oct); Little Chimgan loop (loop, steady, Apr-Jun and Sep-Oct)
uzbekistan.m: Nuratau village-to-village trek (3 to 4 days, homestays, trek, Apr-May and Sep-Oct)

vancouver-island.d: Wild Pacific Trail in Ucluelet (point to point, about 5 miles, easy, year-round); Schooner Cove in Pacific Rim (out and back, about 2.5 miles, easy to steady, year-round); Rainforest Trail (loop, about 1 mile, easy, year-round)
vancouver-island.m: West Coast Trail (6 to 8 days, 47 miles, camping, trek, 1 May-30 Sep)
vancouver-island.st: In July 2026 heavy rain made parts of the West Coast Trail impassable and Parks Canada asked hikers to delay trips and offered refunds; the Nitinaht Triangle remains closed until further notice, and the trail is open to overnight visitors 1 May to 30 Sept with reservations opened on 5 Feb 2026 (Parks Canada).

venice.d: Lido beach and Sant'Erasmo island paths (loop, about 2 to 5 miles, easy, Mar-Nov)

vermont.d: Mount Mansfield by the Sunset Ridge Trail (out and back, about 5 miles, steep, Jun-Oct); Camel's Hump by the Burrows Trail (out and back, about 7 miles, steep, Jun-Oct)
vermont.m: Long Trail (about 3 weeks end to end, 273 miles, shelters, trek, Jun-Oct)

vienna.d: Kahlenberg ridge path (point to point, about 4 to 5 miles, easy, Mar-Nov); Hagenbachklamm gorge (loop, about 3 miles, easy, Apr-Oct)

vietnam.d: Lao Chai to Ta Van near Sapa (point to point, about 7 miles, easy to steady, Mar-May and Sep-Nov)
vietnam.m: Fansipan trek (2 to 3 days, guided, camp, strenuous trek, Mar-Apr and Sep-Nov); Sapa homestay treks (2 to 3 days, village homestays, trek, Mar-May and Sep-Nov)

whistler.d: Garibaldi Lake (out and back, about 11 miles, steady, Jul-Sep); Joffre Lakes (out and back, about 6 miles, steady, Jul-Sep)
whistler.m: Garibaldi Provincial Park backcountry (2 to 3 days, camping with a booking, trek, Jul-Sep)

yellowstone.d: Grand Prismatic Overlook from the Fairy Falls trailhead (out and back, about 2.4 miles, easy to steady, Jun-Sep); Canyon North Rim Trail (point to point, about 3 miles, easy, Jun-Sep)
yellowstone.m: Yellowstone backcountry routes (3 to 7 days, backcountry campsites with a permit, trek, Jul-Sep)
yellowstone.st: Bear-related trail closures near Old Faithful after a May 2026 grizzly incident were lifted by 6 July 2026 (NPS), though one guide still listed Mystic Falls as closed. The closure at Biscuit Basin from the 2024 hydrothermal explosion remains in place. I found no 2026 road closure information.

yosemite.d: Mist Trail to Vernal and Nevada Falls (out and back, about 5.4 miles to Nevada Fall, steep, Apr-Oct); Half Dome (out and back, about 14 miles, strenuous, Jun-Oct; cables permit required); Cathedral Lakes (out and back, about 7 miles, steady, Jul-Sep)
yosemite.m: High Sierra Camps loop (5 to 7 days, about 49 miles, tent cabins by lottery, trek, Jul-Sep)

zambia.d: Guided day walks along the Luangwa River (guided, easy, May-Oct)
zambia.m: Luangwa bush-camp walking safaris (multi-day, guided, bush camps, trek, May-Oct)

zimbabwe.d: Victoria Falls gorge paths (loop, about 2 to 3 miles, easy, Jun-Sep); Mana Pools guided walks (guided, easy, May-Oct)

zion-bryce.d: Angels Landing (out and back, about 5.4 miles with chains, steep, Mar-Nov; permit required); The Narrows bottom-up (out and back, up to 9 miles through the river, steady, Jun-Oct); Navajo Loop at Bryce (loop, about 1.3 miles, steep, Apr-Oct)
zion-bryce.m: West Rim Trail (2 days, about 14 miles, camping with a permit, trek, Mar-Nov)
